result.summary: The main defect is a discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card that reads '-0%', which looks like a formatting or data bug. There is also a minor inconsistency in the favorite (heart) button styling. The rest of the layout (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom nav) renders correctly.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '-0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and suggests a missing value or a formatting bug in the promo badge logic.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or missing, and check that the correct promo percentage is passed to the card.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the Tokumaru Ramen card has a dark, nearly invisible circular background that blends into the dark image. On the pizza card, the same button's backdrop circle is clearly visible. The button styling is inconsistent, and the ramen heart has weaker contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-transparent backdrop (e.g., dark translucent or white) with enough contrast for the heart button on all cards, regardless of the image behind it.
